scope: Additive audit of permanent Home Village Hero collision geometry. It does not replace the Core default radius with an unsourced value.
game_version: Current public pages were consulted on 2026-09-21. No source identifies a client build or publishes a per-Hero collision radius, footprint, or world anchor.

sources.title: About Heroes & Pets
facts: The page identifies the six permanent Home Village Heroes and their Hero Hall unlock rows.
It publishes no combat footprint, collision radius, world anchor, sprite scale, or hitbox value.

sources.title: Pinned Home Village Hero records
facts: The pinned Hero records provide movement, range, cadence, target type, and level values used by the imported catalogue.
The records have no footprint or collision-radius field for Barbarian King, Archer Queen, Grand Warden, Royal Champion, Minion Prince, or Dragon Duke.
sources.limitations: An absent field cannot establish that all Heroes share the simulator default radius or a particular client hitbox.

rejected_inferences.rule: Declare the shared 0.45-tile Core unit radius to be the sourced collision geometry of every Hero.
rejected_inferences.reason: The shared radius is an engine default. Neither the primary source nor the pinned secondary records establish it as a Hero measurement.

rejected_inferences.rule: Derive a Hero hitbox from an icon canvas, Banner image, or apparent sprite size.
rejected_inferences.reason: No public source establishes a world scale, anchor, collision shape, or conversion from presentation pixels to combat geometry.

items: world anchor, battlefield sprite scale, and animation bounds

conclusion: The exact Hero geometry required for client-fidelity collision and presentation remains unavailable in public evidence. Core retains its existing shared unit geometry as a documented fallback, not as a verified Hero-specific value.
